# Historical production build for update tests

`1.10.1.json` and `1.10.1.payload.json.gz` pin the production build generated by release commit **`4e02aee67272e21111875087e6a7a033fed5e4b7`**, version **1.10.1**, cache **`kana-rain-v38-release-1.10.1`**.

This is an intentional compatibility fixture, not a second maintained game implementation. The browser must actually install and play the historical release before the server switches to the candidate at the **same origin**. Using the candidate with only an old version label would not test an upgrade. This fixture keeps the test reproducible in shallow CI checkouts without downloading Git history or contacting production.

The readable manifest lists all 141 files, byte counts and SHA-256 hashes. Historical text/generated files are retained in the compressed base64 payload; identical artwork and recordings reuse local public assets only when their hashes match the historical manifest. No learner export, browser profile or private release metadata is included. Progress is generated synthetically using the historical Learner API at test time.

If a shared image/recording changes, the test must fail until the old bytes are deliberately retained or the fixture is reviewed and regenerated. Do not silently substitute the new asset. The helper also rejects a stale candidate `dist/`.

To reproduce the fixture, run from the repository root with the pinned commit available locally (use a new empty extraction directory):

```powershell
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path .release/update-baseline-rebuild
git archive --format=tar --output=.release/update-baseline-rebuild/source.tar 4e02aee67272e21111875087e6a7a033fed5e4b7 01-kana-rain
tar -xf .release/update-baseline-rebuild/source.tar -C .release/update-baseline-rebuild
node .release/update-baseline-rebuild/01-kana-rain/scripts/build.cjs
node 01-kana-rain/tests/helpers/update-fixture.cjs --capture .release/update-baseline-rebuild/01-kana-rain/dist
```

Review the manifest/payload diff and rerun `pnpm build` followed by `pnpm test:update` inside `01-kana-rain`. Repacking this baseline does not make it the latest release: adding a different baseline requires an explicit version/commit/cache update and review.

This fixture and the test helpers are excluded by the production build allowlist.
